title: Children's Health Plan Plus (CHP+) — Yuma County Department of Human Services — 340 S Birch St - Yuma County
summary: Provides public low-cost health insurance for children and pregnant women whose households earn too much to qualify for Health First Colorado (Colorado’s Medicaid program), but not enough to afford private health insurance. Coverage may include:    Primary care   Emergency care and urgent care   Hospital services   Dental care   Prescriptions   Immunizations   Maternity care    Behavioral healthcare  Vision healthcare

title: Low-Income Energy Assistance Program (LEAP) — Yuma County Department of Human Services — 910 S Main - Yuma County
summary: The Low-Income Energy Assistance Program (LEAP) is a federally funded program that helps eligible Colorado households with a portion of their winter home heating costs. Applications are accepted each year from November 1st - April 30th. The benefit does not cover the full cost of heating and is offered once per season. LEAP payments are made directly to the household’s primary heating fuel vendor or utility. Household types may include those using fuels such as:   Wood   Coal   Propane   Heat billed on a shared meter

fields.organization name: Yuma County Department of Human Services
fields.service summary: The Low-Income Energy Assistance Program (LEAP) is a federally funded program that helps eligible Colorado households with a portion of their winter home heating costs. Applications are accepted each year from November 1st - April 30th. The benefit does not cover the full cost of heating and is offered once per season. LEAP payments are made directly to the household’s primary heating fuel vendor or utility. Household types may include those using fuels such as:   Wood   Coal   Propane   Heat billed on a shared meter
fields.eligibility: Applicants must:    Be a permanent legal resident of the United States and Colorado, or have a household member that is a US citizen   Pay home heating costs to a heating provider, fuel dealer, or landlord as part of rent   Have a maximum household income that falls within the guidelines below    'Household” means people who live with you and for whom you are financially responsible. Household Size Monthly Gross Income for the 2025-2026 Season                 60% of State Median Income    1 - $3,607  2 - $4,717  3 - $5,827  4 - $6,938  5 - $8,048  6 - $9,158  7 - $9,366  8 - $9,574  Each Additional Person $208    Area Served: Yuma County
fields.access method: Apply online. Visit the website to download a paper application and drop off at the local DHS office or mail/email to the county to process. Call to request a mailed paper application, to apply over the phone, or for more information.
fields.required documents: Must provide:    Proof of citizenship if born outside of the US   Proof of all monthly household income    If self-employed, receipts for all expenses claimed on profit and loss statement   Copy of most recent heating bill or recent rent receipt, if heat is included with rent
fields.hours of operation: November 1st - April 30th (Application Open); Monday - Friday, 8:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. (Administrative Hours)
